item.text:
**Bottom Line**
Mixed, leaning negative. AMLO kept parts of the macro/investment framework technocratic and stable, but 2024 also brought major institutional changes that worsened contract enforcement, judicial independence, and investor confidence. Direct evidence on entrepreneurship and competition policy was sparse; most of the evidence runs through courts, transparency bodies, and investment climate.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Mexican finance minister seeks to soothe investors, reduce public debt](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexican-finance-minister-seeks-to-soothe-investors-reduce-public-debt-3470241) — Reuters, 2024-06-04. Ramírez de la O stayed on, promised debt reduction and fiscal discipline, and explicitly backed central bank autonomy, rule of law, and private investment. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.2`, `5B.3`.

- [Mexico: Staff Concluding Statement of the 2024 Article IV Mission](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/15/mcs-mexico-staff-concluding-statement-of-the-2024-aiv-mission) — IMF, 2024-10-15. The IMF said Mexico still had very strong macro/institutional frameworks and that its FCL qualification rested on that track record, which is positive for predictable business conditions. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`.

- [Mexico: 2024 Article IV Consultation and Review Under the Flexible Credit Line Arrangement](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/11/01/mexico-2024-article-iv-consultation-and-review-under-the-flexible-credit-line-arrangement-556997) — IMF, 2024-11-01. The report said sustainable growth needed better supply-side reforms, more competition, stronger business conditions, and fewer barriers to financial entry, which is a constructive but conditional assessment. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`.

- [Informe trimestral abr-jun 2024](https://www.banxico.org.mx/publicaciones-y-prensa/resumenes-visuales/informe-trimestral-html/informe-trimestral-abr-jun-00003.html) — Banco de México, 2024-08-28. Banxico kept policy aligned with the 3 percent inflation target and a low-stable-inflation environment, supporting predictable investment conditions. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`.

- [Economía de México es sólida y hay responsabilidad en manejo de finanzas: presidente](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/economia-de-mexico-es-solida-y-hay-responsabilidad-en-manejo-de-finanzas-presidente/) — Presidencia de México, 2024-06-04. AMLO defended keeping the existing economic rules because stability mattered, which is limited positive evidence for rule predictability rather than arbitrary intervention. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`.

- [Analysis-Mexico investors worry lopsided vote could threaten rule of law](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/analysismexico-investors-worry-lopsided-vote-could-threaten-rule-of-law-3475796) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-07. Investors feared AMLO might use his post-election mandate to sweep aside checks on presidential power, which cut against long-term investment confidence. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `4B.10`.

- [Mexico's judicial reform stokes investor fears, though some analysts bullish](https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/analysismexicos-judicial-reform-stokes-investor-fears-though-some-analysts-bullish-3618899) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-17. Reuters reported the reform triggered uncertainty over rule of law and institutions, with direct downside for private investment and contract enforcement. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`, `4B.10`.

- [Mexico's sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-15. The overhaul ended judge appointment as the norm, which critics said weakened judicial independence and investor confidence. IDs: `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `5B.3`.

- [Mexican lower house approves controversial judicial reform](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-lower-house-approves-controversial-judicial-reform-3600068) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-04. Reuters described the reform as controversial and a major step toward changing the judiciary in ways critics said would undercut independent adjudication. IDs: `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `5B.3`.

- [Mexico proposed constitutional changes threaten rights](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/30/mexico-proposed-constitutional-changes-threaten-rights) — Human Rights Watch, 2024-08-30. HRW warned the reform package could weaken judicial independence, expand military power, and erode privacy/transparency safeguards, all of which harm fair rules for investment and competition. IDs: `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `4B.9`.

- [World Report 2024: Mexico](https://www.hrw.org/es/world-report/2024/country-chapters/mexico) — Human Rights Watch, 2024. HRW said AMLO and his party blocked INAI appointments, leaving the transparency/data-protection body unable to function normally and weakening rule-based market oversight. IDs: `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `4B.9`.

- [Moody's cuts indebted oil firm Pemex's rating by two notches to B3](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/moodys-cuts-indebted-oil-firm-033156859.html) — Reuters, 2024-02-09. Moody’s said fiscal deterioration, higher borrowing costs, social spending, and flagship projects strained government support for Pemex, a negative sign for fiscal discipline and investment conditions. IDs: `5B.4`, `5B.3`.

- [Senate approved reform giving armed forces control of National Guard](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-senators-push-through-reform-to-boost-military-control-over-security-3632396) — Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-25. Critics said giving the military more law-and-order power expanded coercive authority, which can chill entrepreneurship and investment even if it is not a direct business regulation. IDs: `5B.4`, `4B.10`, `5B.3`.

**Search Gap**
I found strong evidence on courts, transparency, and investor confidence, but little direct 2024 evidence on classic entrepreneurship rules such as antitrust enforcement, procurement fairness, licensing reform, or property-rights administration at the firm level. The clearest story is indirect: AMLO preserved some macro stability, but the judiciary and oversight changes made the business rule environment less predictable.
